steps.label: Bug Hunt
steps.content:
Year 6 Scratch

Bug Hunt

Year 6, 6.2.4.6

  • Say what a bug is: expected against actual.
  • Follow the same steps to hunt every bug.
  • Find and fix the bugs in six broken games.

steps.label: What Is a Bug?
steps.content:
What Is a Bug?

A bug is where what should happen (expected) and what does happen (actual) are different.

Think → Pair → ShareThe Ship should move left. It moves right. What is expected? What is actual? Is it a bug?Show the answer

Expected: the Ship moves left. Actual: it moves right. They are different, so it is a bug.

I didExpectedActualBug?
Held the left arrowShip moves leftShip moves rightYes
Popped a balloonscore goes up by 1score goes up by 1No
Got hit 3 timesGame OverThe game kept goingYes

steps.label: Check: Bug or Not?
steps.content:
Check: Bug or Not?

Compare expected and actual.

items.prompt: Expected: time counts down 20, 19, 18. Actual: time counts 20, 21, 22. Is it a bug?
items.explain: Expected and actual are different, so it is a bug.

items.prompt: Expected: the Ghost keeps moving. Actual: the Ghost keeps moving. Is it a bug?
items.explain: Expected and actual are the same, so that part works.

steps.label: How to Hunt a Bug
steps.content:
How to Hunt a Bug

The same five steps work for every bug.

Think → Pair → ShareWhy change only one thing before you test again?Show the answer

If it works, you know which change fixed it. If it breaks, you know which change to undo.

  1. Play the game. Watch carefully.
  2. Say what you expected and what actually happened.
  3. Find the script for that part of the game.
  4. Change one thing.
  5. Test again. Still wrong? Back to step 3.
if <key [left arrow v] pressed?> then
change x by (8)
end

steps.label: Bug Hunt 1: Meteor Dodge
steps.content:
Bug Hunt 1: Meteor Dodge

Work on your own. Play first, then find the bug and fix it.

Think → Pair → SharePredict: which blocks make the Ship move? Where will you look first?Show the answer

The if blocks inside the Ship's forever loop. One checks the right arrow, one checks the left arrow. Left should change x by a negative number.

What should happen

  • The arrow keys steer the Ship left and right.
  • A Meteor that falls past adds 1 to score.
  • A Meteor that hits the Ship takes 1 life.

Clue: test each arrow key on its own.

Press Check my project as often as you like. Green ticks show the parts that already work.

steps.label: Bug Hunt 2: Meteor Dodge Never Ends
steps.content:
Bug Hunt 2: Meteor Dodge Never Ends

Work on your own. Play first, then find the bug and fix it.

Think → Pair → Sharelives goes 3, 2, 1, 0. What should the Stage wait for? Could lives ever be less than 0?Show the answer

It should wait until lives = 0. lives stops at 0, so "less than 0" is never true and the game never ends.

What should happen

  • Each hit takes 1 life. lives starts at 3.
  • When lives reaches 0, the Game Over screen shows.
  • Then the game stops.

Clue: count the lives out loud. Then read what the Stage is waiting for.

Press Check my project as often as you like. Green ticks show the parts that already work.

steps.label: Bug Hunt 3: Balloon Pop
steps.content:
Bug Hunt 3: Balloon Pop

Work on your own. Play first, then find the bug and fix it.

Think → Pair → ShareWhat is the difference between set [score] to (1) and change [score] by (1)?Show the answer

set replaces the value with 1 every time. change adds 1 to the value it already has.

What should happen

  • Each click on the red Balloon adds 1 to score.
  • Each click on the Gold Balloon adds 5.
  • time counts down from 20. At 0, Time Up.

Clue: click the red Balloon three times and watch score.

Press Check my project as often as you like. Green ticks show the parts that already work.

steps.label: Where Bugs Hide
steps.content:
Where Bugs Hide

What you see tells you where to look.

Think → Pair → ShareBug Hunt 3: score was stuck at 1. Which kind of bug was that?Show the answer

A value gets stuck: the click script used set when it should use change.

Goes the wrong wayLook at the numbers in the move and change blocks. Is one positive when it should be negative?
Happens once, then stopsBlocks that should keep running need to be inside a forever or repeat loop.
A value gets stuckRead the blocks that change it. Does it say set when it should say change?
Something never happensRead the condition. Which sprite does it check? Can the comparison ever be true?

steps.label: Bug Hunt 4: Balloon Pop Timer
steps.content:
Bug Hunt 4: Balloon Pop Timer

Work on your own. Play first, then find the bug and fix it.

Think → Pair → ShareThe time box shows 20, 21, 22. Which kind of bug is that?Show the answer

It goes the wrong way. The change [time] by block should use -1, not 1.

What should happen

  • time starts at 20.
  • time goes down by 1 every second.
  • At 0, the Time Up screen shows and the game stops.

Clue: watch the time box. Which way is it going?

steps.label: Bug Hunt 5: Ghost Maze
steps.content:
Bug Hunt 5: Ghost Maze

Work on your own. Play first, then find the bug and fix it.

Think → Pair → ShareThe Ghost glides there and back once, then stops. Which kind of bug is that?Show the answer

Happens once, then stops. The two glide blocks need to go inside a forever loop.

What should happen

  • The arrow keys move the Hero. Walls stop it.
  • The Ghost patrols back and forth, forever.
  • The Ghost sends the Hero back to the start.

Clue: watch the Ghost for 10 seconds.

Press Check my project as often as you like. Green ticks show the parts that already work.

steps.label: Bug Hunt 6: Ghost Maze Locked Door
steps.content:
Bug Hunt 6: Ghost Maze Locked Door

Work on your own. Play first, then find the bug and fix it.

Think → Pair → ShareYou have the key and you are at the Door. Nothing happens. Which kind of bug is that?Show the answer

Something never happens. The Door waits until it touches the Ghost, not the Hero.

What should happen

  • Touching the Key collects it: keys becomes 1.
  • With the key, touching the Door opens it.
  • Then You Escaped shows.

Clue: collect the Key, then go to the Door. Read what the Door is waiting for.
